title: quantbox config explain (explain@1)
description: What `quantbox config explain <config> --json` prints: how the runner will resolve a config, without running it. Fields shared with quantbox/run@1 (asof, mode, pipeline, config_hash, config.sha256, plugins, engine, dataset.{name,sha256,source,tier}, funding, execution, run, venue, overlays, n_trials) carry the SAME names and meanings as run@1, so a plan and the manifest of the run it plans compare key by key. One is a plan rather than a record: funding.modelled is true when the engine charges funding and a funding file exists. When ok is false, `errors` says why the run could not start and the plan fields may be absent. VERSIONING: as run@1 — adding a field bumps x-schema-minor; renaming, removing or re-meaning one ships as explain@2.

ok.description: true when every plugin id, the dataset and the pipeline params resolve; the CLI exits non-zero otherwise.

plugins_resolved.description: Every plugin id the config names resolves — including publishers, validation and monitors, which a run resolves only after the pipeline.

market.description: The dataset's market (its manifest.yaml), for a dataset read by name; else null.

rebalancing.description: Backtest pipelines (minor 2, TOM-1450): the rebalancing policy the engine seam will apply, as plan() resolved it (quantbox.engine.policy: policy, frequency, calendar, and tranches / band / width + bounds). Minor 3 (TOM-1513) adds cadence and trigger (a policy is a cadence x a trigger); policy is their single-key name, or cadence+trigger when there is none. Not a run@1 field: data_validation.json records it for the run.

group_limits.description: Backtest pipelines (minor 2, TOM-1450): the group limits on the decided weights (by, excess, limits); null when none are declared.

variant.description: Set for a strategy of a multi-variant run.

params_init.description: Constructor params as instantiated, defaults filled.

artifacts_root.description: Absolute directory the run will write artifacts/<run_id>/ under.
